sloka: महत्सु तस्य शैलेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च ।विचिन्वत महाभागाम् राम पत्नीम् अनिन्दिताम् ॥४-४३-१५॥
transliteration: mahatsu tasya śaileṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca ।vicinvata mahābhāgām rāma patnīm aninditām ॥4-43-15॥

translations.english: 'Then go and explore the hermitage of Soma inhabited by gods and gandharvas and also the great summits of mount Kala.
